  PROBLEM: The temporary `review_dependency_git_mask` directory is created by `mktemp -d` and only cleaned up at the end of the outer `if` block, with no `trap` registered on EXIT/HUP/INT/TERM.
  WHY: When the outer step is killed mid-`docker run`, control never reaches line 4127 and the mask directory survives in `${RUNNER_TEMP}` until the runner cleans it post-job.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml: lines 4110-4120 (LAST RUN DIFF; the `docker run … python:3.12-slim` invocation in the "Install project dependencies (best-effort)" step) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The LAST RUN DIFF removed `--network none` from the dependency-installation container without replacing it with any restricted network policy.
  WHY: A PR-controlled dependency build hook can read workspace files and exfiltrate them to arbitrary hosts because the container has full outbound network access.
- TASK_GAP | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  Requirement: "Install and test PR dependencies in an isolated disposable container with no secrets, runner command files, authenticated Git metadata, or unrestricted network access." (linked issue #4270 / #4139 finding `review-pr-build-hooks-run-with-pat`, severity=critical, confidence=10, location `.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:4102`)
  Expected change site: `.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml`, "Install project dependencies (best-effort)" step, the `docker run … python:3.12-slim` invocation
  Evidence of absence: The four sub-requirements map to no secrets, no runner command files, and no authenticated Git metadata being satisfied, but unrestricted network access is NOT satisfied because the LAST RUN deliberately removed `--network none` and added no replacement restriction; `test_dependency_install_container_can_download_without_git_metadata` asserts `"--network none" not in step`.
